mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_derivation_rule(rule_code,knowledge_base_id,preset_code,name, derivation_type,schedule_type,cron_expr,next_fire_at,source_scope_json,definition_json,algorithm_version,created_by) VALUES(#{ruleCode},#{kb},#{presetCode},#{name},#{derivationType},#{scheduleType},#{cronExpr},#{nextFireAt}, CAST(#{sourceScopeJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{definitionJson} AS JSON),#{algorithmVersion},#{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT rule_code ruleCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, preset_code presetCode,name,derivation_type derivationType,enabled,schedule_type scheduleType,cron_expr cronExpr, next_fire_at nextFireAt,last_fire_at lastFireAt,source_scope_json sourceScopeJson, definition_json definitionJson,algorithm_version algorithmVersion,status,last_error lastError, created_by createdBy,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime FROM t_derivation_rule WHERE rule_code=#{ruleCode}

SELECT rule_code ruleCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, preset_code presetCode,name,derivation_type derivationType,enabled,schedule_type scheduleType,cron_expr cronExpr, next_fire_at nextFireAt,last_fire_at lastFireAt,source_scope_json sourceScopeJson, definition_json definitionJson,algorithm_version algorithmVersion,status,last_error lastError, created_by createdBy,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_derived_candidate c WHERE c.rule_code=r.rule_code) candidateCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_derived_candidate c WHERE c.rule_code=r.rule_code AND c.status='STALE') staleCount FROM t_derivation_rule r WHERE (knowledge_base_id=#{kb} OR #{kb} IS NULL) ORDER BY enabled DESC,created_time DESC
SELECT preset_code FROM t_derivation_rule WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND preset_code IS NOT NULL

SELECT rule_code ruleCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, name,derivation_type derivationType,schedule_type scheduleType,cron_expr cronExpr, source_scope_json sourceScopeJson,definition_json definitionJson,algorithm_version algorithmVersion FROM t_derivation_rule WHERE enabled=1 AND schedule_type='SCHEDULED' AND next_fire_at IS NOT NULL AND next_fire_at<=#{now} AND (status IS NULL OR status!='RUNNING') ORDER BY next_fire_at LIMIT 5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_derived_candidate(candidate_code,knowledge_base_id,rule_code, derivation_type,algorithm_version,title,content,confidence,status,base_assertion_codes,graph_path, evidence_json,derived_from_json,permission_tags,authority_score,content_hash,created_by) VALUES(#{candidateCode},#{kb},#{ruleCode},#{derivationType},#{algorithmVersion},#{title},#{content},#{confidence}, 'DRAFT',CAST(#{baseAssertionCodes} AS JSON),CAST(#{graphPath} AS JSON),CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{derivedFromJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{permissionTags} AS JSON),#{authorityScore},#{contentHash},#{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_derived_candidate SET confidence=#{confidence}, status=#{status},stale_reason=NULL WHERE rule_code=#{ruleCode} AND content_hash=#{contentHash}
mapper.select: SELECT candidate_code candidateCode, knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,rule_code ruleCode,derivation_type derivationType, algorithm_version algorithmVersion,title,content,confidence,status, base_assertion_codes baseAssertionCodes,graph_path graphPath,evidence_json evidenceJson, derived_from_json derivedFromJson,permission_tags permissionTags,authority_score authorityScore, stale_reason staleReason,created_by createdBy,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime FROM t_derived_candidate WHERE candidate_code=#{candidateCode}
SELECT candidate_code candidateCode,status FROM t_derived_candidate WHERE rule_code=#{ruleCode} AND content_hash=#{contentHash}

SELECT candidate_code candidateCode, knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,rule_code ruleCode,derivation_type derivationType, algorithm_version algorithmVersion,title,confidence,status,base_assertion_codes baseAssertionCodes, stale_reason staleReason,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime, JSON_LENGTH(base_assertion_codes) baseCount FROM t_derived_candidate WHERE (knowledge_base_id=#{kb} OR #{kb} IS NULL) AND status=#{status} AND rule_code=#{ruleCode} ORDER BY FIELD(status,'DRAFT','STALE','PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED'),confidence DESC,created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_derived_candidate SET status=#{status}, stale_reason=#{staleReason} WHERE candidate_code=#{candidateCode}
mapper.select:
SELECT candidate_code candidateCode,status FROM t_derived_candidate WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','APPROVED')
JSON_CONTAINS(base_assertion_codes,CONCAT('"',#{code},'"'))

SELECT a.entity_code headCode,a.canonical_name headName, b.entity_code midCode,b.canonical_name midName,c.entity_code tailCode,c.canonical_name tailName, r1.relation_type firstType,r2.relation_type secondType,r1.relation_code firstRelationCode, r2.relation_code secondRelationCode,r1.confidence firstConfidence,r2.confidence secondConfidence FROM t_relation r1 JOIN t_relation r2 ON r2.source_entity_id=r1.target_entity_id JOIN t_entity a ON a.id=r1.source_entity_id JOIN t_entity b ON b.id=r1.target_entity_id JOIN t_entity c ON c.id=r2.target_entity_id WHERE r1.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND r2.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (#{firstType} IS NULL OR r1.relation_type=#{firstType}) AND (#{secondType} IS NULL OR r2.relation_type=#{secondType}) AND IFNULL(r1.confidence,0)>=#{minConfidence} AND IFNULL(r2.confidence,0)>=#{minConfidence} AND IFNULL(r1.status,'ACTIVE')='ACTIVE' AND IFNULL(r2.status,'ACTIVE')='ACTIVE' AND a.id<>c.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.relation_code relationCode,r.relation_type relationType, s.entity_code sourceCode,s.canonical_name sourceName,t.entity_code targetCode,t.canonical_name targetName, IFNULL(r.confidence,0) confidence FROM t_relation r JOIN t_entity s ON s.id=r.source_entity_id JOIN t_entity t ON t.id=r.target_entity_id WHERE r.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND IFNULL(r.status,'ACTIVE')='ACTIVE' AND IFNULL(r.confidence,0)>=#{minConfidence} ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT claim_code claimCode,subject,predicate, object_value objectValue,confidence,status,permission_tags permissionTags,version -- Deriving from a conflicting or uncertain assertion would launder doubt into a -- conclusion; pending review is still a statement the source stands behind. FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND IFNULL(confidence,0)>=#{minConfidence} AND IFNULL(status,'PENDING_REVIEW') IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE','ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW') ORDER BY confidence DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
